title: health_check_endpoint_returns_ok_status
description: Verify that GET /health returns a 200 response with an ok status when the backend service is running normally.

title: voice_listing_returns_available_tts_providers_and_voices
description: Verify that GET /api/voices returns a 200 response with the list of available text-to-speech providers and voice models.

title: voice_preview_streams_audio_sample_for_valid_parameters
description: Verify that GET /api/voices/preview with valid voice and provider parameters returns a 200 response streaming a short audio sample for voice preview.

title: video_generation_job_creation_starts_pipeline_and_returns_job_id
description: Verify that POST /api/jobs with valid idea, duration, style, voice, and voice_provider returns a 200 response with job details including job_id and starts the background video generation pipeline.

title: job_status_polling_returns_current_status_for_existing_job
description: Verify that GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/status for an existing in-progress job returns a 200 response with current status and progress details.

title: download_video_returns_mp4_file_for_completed_job
description: Verify that GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/download for a completed job returns a 200 response with the MP4 video file for download.

title: user_feedback_submission_accepts_valid_message
description: Verify that POST /api/feedback with a valid message and optional contact information returns a 200 response confirming feedback submission.
